subject: SOC2 / ISO audit vendor — RFP, finalists & 2026 renewal
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Clara Diaz <clara.diaz@kestrel-audit.com>, Dan Li <dan.li@sableadvisory.com>, contracts@bluebridge.com
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SOC2 / ISO audit vendor — RFP, finalists & 2026 renewal

Hi Clara / Dan / Contracts team,

Thanks for your time last quarter. We're starting the procurement cycle for our SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 annual assessment for the 2026 period (renewal + expanded scope). We're running a short RFP to pick the audit firm for the coming 12 months with an option to extend for two additional years.

High level scope:
- SOC 2 (CCPA, availability + confidentiality common criteria) Type II (full coverage)
- ISO 27001 surveillance + re-certification readiness (gap assessment + one onsite)
- Evidence collection support, control-testing window: Apr 15 – May 30

What we need from you by end-of-day Tuesday, Feb 18:
1) Proposed SOW (line-item pricing + fixed fee for the engagement)
2) Timeline & resource plan (onsite days, remote testing hours)
3) Standard contract terms / sample DPA & insurance info
4) Any suggested reductions for multi-year commit (optional)

Attached: 2026_Redwood_SOC2_Scope.pdf and our SOC questionnaire (redwood-soc2-questionnaire.xlsx).

Internal notes: Aditya and Monica are on the review loop for pricing and legal. Markus — please keep an eye on insurance/indemnity language as we iterate.

Thanks,
Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: 2026_Redwood_SOC2_Scope.pdf] [Attachment: redwood-soc2-questionnaire.xlsx]

From: Clara Diaz <clara.diaz@kestrel-audit.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 11:38:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC2 / ISO audit vendor — RFP, finalists & 2026 renewal

Hi Laura —

Appreciate the invite. Kestrel would be keen to support Redwood for the 2026 SOC 2 & ISO work. We reviewed the scope and a few quick clarifying Qs before preparing the SOW:

- Can you confirm the number of in-scope applications and deployed regions (we assume US + EU)?
- For ISO, do you want full re-certification or surveillance + re-certification readiness?

We can provide a fixed-fee SOW for the SOC 2 Type II window and a separate line item for ISO. Attached is our draft SOW (Kestrel_SOW_v2.pdf) and a preliminary pricing sheet. Our standard approach includes 3 onsite days for ISO gap/controls. For the SOC 2 testing window, estimated onsite support is optional — most workable via remote evidence collection.

Key terms: we will propose a liability cap tied to fees (standard practice) — willing to discuss incrementally for enterprise contracts.

I'll put a short pricing summary in the SOW and can join a 30-min call next week to walk through details.

Thanks,
Clara Diaz
Principal, Kestrel Audit
clara.diaz@kestrel-audit.com
[Attachment: Kestrel_SOW_v2.pdf]

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Feb 2026 08:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC2 / ISO audit vendor — RFP, finalists & 2026 renewal

Quick read-through of responses so far:
- Kestrel: detailed SOW, reasonable fixed-fee option, standard liability cap. Good delivery/partner references.
- Sable (Dan): responsive, slightly lower price but asks for a retention period for follow-up consulting; may push for advisory upsell.
- BlueBridge (contracts@bluebridge.com) has not returned a full SOW yet (asked for more detail).

Recommendation: shortlist Kestrel + Sable for final negotiation. Primary negotiation items for legal/procurement: fixed-fee certainty, liability cap alignment with our procurement policy (prefer 3x fee or $1M floor), SLA on reporting timelines, and DPA updates for EU data flow.

Next steps:
1) Book 30-min calls with Kestrel and Sable this week — get final commercial marks.
2) Monica to coordinate with Legal for redlines on the selected SOW.
3) Markus to sign off on insurance/indemnity items.

-Aditya

From: Dan Li <dan.li@sableadvisory.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 16:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC2 / ISO audit vendor — RFP, finalists & 2026 renewal

Laura / team —

Thanks for the RFP. We're happy to submit a competitive proposal. Attached is Sable_SOW_v1.pdf with a fixed-fee option for SOC 2 Type II and a combined bundle price if you take SOC + ISO with a 2-year commit.

Summary (high level):
- SOC 2 Type II fixed fee: USD 72,500 (covers evidence collection support, 2 remote auditors for test window)
- SOC 2 + ISO bundle (2-yr commit): USD 125,000/year (includes one onsite ISO day per year + surveillance)
- Standard terms: $1M liability cap; we can discuss higher caps with insurance proof.

We can do a walkthrough call Friday 19 Feb 10:00 PT or the week of Feb 22. Happy to be flexible.

Regards,
Dan Li
Director, Sable Advisory
dan.li@sableadvisory.com
[Attachment: Sable_SOW_v1.pdf]

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Clara Diaz <clara.diaz@kestrel-audit.com>, Dan Li <dan.li@sableadvisory.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Mar 2026 14:45:00 -0800
Subject: Finalist selection & next steps — Kestrel selected for 2026 renewal

Hi Clara / Dan —

Thank you both for the quick turn on proposals and the detailed SOWs. After internal review and reference checks, we are selecting Kestrel Audit as our preferred vendor for the 2026 SOC 2 Type II and ISO surveillance work.

A few items to address in the final SOW/contract before signature:
- Liability cap: we prefer a 3x fee cap with a $1.5M floor; please include insurance certs.
- SLA: final report delivery within 30 days of test window close (May 30).
- Data transfers: include DPA language aligning with EU data transfer mechanisms (we will share standard DPA redlines).
- Payment terms: net 45, with a 10% holdback until final report delivery.

Monica (contracts) will be the formal procurement contact to drive contract redlines. Monica — please confirm availability to review Kestrel_SOW_v2 and circulate comment set by Mar 6.

Clara — can you send a final SOW reflecting the items above and a DocuSign-ready contract link? If you can get that to us by Mar 6 we can aim to have signature and kickoff before mid-March.

Dan — thank you for the proposal. We'll keep Sable in the vendor pool for future advisory work and appreciate the competitive bid.

Best,
Laura
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: 2026_Redwood_SOC2_Scope.pdf]
